translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Jaricho ringo kaonge ngʼama lawe,
to joma kare jochir ka sibuor.
Ka piny toke tek, to en gi jotelo mangʼeny,
to ngʼat mawinjo wach kendo man-gi ngʼeyo rito chik.
Jatelo mahinyo jochan
chalo kaka kodh oula maywero cham oko.
Jogo ma ok rit chik pako ngʼat marach,
to jogo marito chik dagi jogo maricho.
Jomaricho ok ongʼeyo adiera,
to jogo madwaro Jehova Nyasaye ongʼeyo adiera chutho.
Ber ngʼat ma jachan ma wuodhe ok cha,
moloyo ngʼat ma ja-mwandu ma yorene richo.
Ngʼat marito chik en wuowi mariek,
to bedo osiep jawuoro kelo wichkuot ne wuon mare.
Ngʼat mamedo mwandu gi ohala ma malangʼ choko mwandu ne ngʼat machielo,
mabiro bedo mangʼwon gi jochan.
Ka ngʼato odino ite ne chik,
kata mana lemone bende richo.
Ngʼat matero ngʼat moriere tir e yo mar richo
biro podho e obetone owuon,
to ngʼat ma ok cha biro yudo pok maber.
Jamoko nyalo paro owuon ni oriek,
to jachan man-gi paro matut neno gik manie chuny jamokono.
Ka ngʼat makare oloyo, nitie mor maduongʼ,
to ka ngʼat marach omi teko mondo otel,
ji ringo dhiyo kar pondo.
Ngʼat mapando richone ok dhi maber,
to ngʼat ma hulo richone kendo oweyogi yudo ngʼwono.
En ngʼama ogwedhi ngʼat moluoro Jehova Nyasaye kinde duto,
to ngʼatno ma chunye tek donjo e chandruok.
Kaka sibuor maruto kata ondiek madwaro kecho
e kaka ngʼat marach motelone joma ok nyal.
Ruoth ma jasunga onge gi rieko,
to ngʼatno mamon gi gik moyud e yo marach biro dak amingʼa.
Ngʼat moneko chunye chandore
enobed gi kuyo nyaka otho;
omiyo kik ngʼato konye.
Ngʼatno ma ja-adiera ibiro rito maonge hinyruok,
to ngʼatno ma yorene richo biro podho apoya nono.
Ngʼat matiyo e puothe biro bedo gi chiemo mogundho,
to ngʼat mabayo abaya biro bedo jachan mochwere.
Ngʼat ma ja-adiera ibiro gwedho mangʼeny,
to ngʼat madwaro gi teko bedo ja-mwandu ok notony ma ok okume.
Dok ne ngʼato kayiem ka oketho ok ber,
to ngʼato biro timo marach mana ni mondo oyud asoya matin.
Ngʼat ma iye lit dwaro ahinya ni mondo obed gi mwandu
to ok ongʼeyo ni chan orite.
Ngʼatno makwero ngʼato gikone obiro yudo pwoch mangʼeny
moloyo ngʼatno man-gi lep mawuondo.
Ngʼat mamayo wuon mare kata min,
to owacho niya, “Timo kamano ok rach,”
ochal gi ngʼat maketho gimoro.
Ngʼat ma jawuoro thoro kelo miero,
to ngʼat mogeno kuom Jehova Nyasaye biro dhiyo maber.
Ngʼat moketo genone kuome owuon ofuwo,
to ngʼatno mawuotho e rieko, oritore maonge hinyruok.
Ngʼat mamiyo jochan ok nochand gimoro,
to ngʼat ma gengʼo wangʼe ne jochan noyud kwongʼ mangʼeny.
Ka jaricho oketi e teko mondo otel, ji dhiyo kar pondo;
to ka jaricho otho joma kare dhiyo nyime.
